record.body:
## Description

Rewrite plan-trace and related consistency expectations so they enforce atomic deliver/repair ids, thin acceptances, optional criterion, and original-text brief skill text — including a CLI-backed create/capture path for the thin shape.

## Approach

1. Rewrite tests/test_plan_trace.py: drop omit-when-no-spec assertions for deliver/repair requirements; assert skill text requires atomic ids and thin acceptances; assert criterion is optional in the contract (test name criterion_optional_in_contract); assert create/capture examples match; keep or add a test that drives adaptive-artifacts create/capture for a thin deliver acceptance (integration through the real CLI).
2. Keep tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py green after skill/contract changes (fix skill_extraction required-field set if needed).
3. Touch only tests and helpers needed for these assertions — not product skills/contract (already landed by prior tasks).
